method.quest: 75 contracts, recommended level, cheapest compatible head/body gifted, 8 teams (2 mixed + all 6 triples), seeds 1..12 per team. 96 observations/quest. Wilson interval describes this fixed mixture, not arbitrary players.

definitions.casualty: member condition Dead; wounds reported separately

limits: Fresh gear acquisition is not charged in quest matrix; campaigns charge it.
Synthetic fixed policies, not human play. No user saves.
No numeric balance changes inferred solely from aggregates.
Camp time is simulated, not wall-clock/native soak.
